newsitem.title: USA: XCL Ltd omits preferred stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: XCL Ltd omits preferred stock dividend.

text.p: XCL Ltd said on Wednesday it had elected not to declare payment of its regular semiannual December 31, 1996 dividend on its series A, cumulative convertible preferred stock.
XCL Ltd said the series A cumualtive covertible preferred shares are traded on the London Stock Exchange.
XCL said it has a loan agreement that prohibits the company from making cash dividends on the series A cumulative convertible preferred stock.
The company's last dividend was December 1995, which was a stock dividend, an XCL spokeswoman said.
The company is allowed to issue more of the cumulative convertible preferred shares in the place of the dividends, an XCL spokeswoman said.
The company was unable to sell enough shares to cover the taxes involved in making a share distribution, the XCL spokeswoman said.
